name: AquaShield Water-Based Polyurethane
surface_prep: Sand to 180-220 grit, remove dust with a tack cloth. Bare wood only; no wax or silicone residue.
description: A fast-drying, low-odor water-based polyurethane that stays clear over time and resists yellowing. Popular for interior floors and furniture where a durable, easy-cleanup finish is needed.

name: ClearCoat Pro Oil-Based Polyurethane
surface_prep: Sand to 180-220 grit. Stir gently, do not shake. Apply in a well-ventilated area.
description: A traditional oil-based polyurethane that builds a thick, amber-toned, highly durable film. Slower drying than water-based formulas but well suited to high-wear surfaces like floors and tabletops.

name: WoodArmor Conversion Varnish
surface_prep: Sand to 220 grit, seal with matching sanding sealer, and add catalyst per the product label before spraying.
description: A catalyzed conversion varnish built for cabinet shops and commercial millwork. Cures to a hard, chemical- and moisture-resistant film once catalyzed. Spray application only.

name: DeckDefend Marine Spar Varnish
use_cases: Exterior Decking, Marine & Boat, Outdoor Furniture
surface_prep: Sand to 150-180 grit. Wipe with a solvent-dampened cloth to remove salt or grime before the first coat.
description: A flexible, UV-resistant spar varnish formulated to move with wood exposed to sun, rain, and temperature swings. Traditional choice for brightwork on boats and outdoor furniture.

name: PureTone Danish Oil
application_method: Wipe-on with a cloth or brush, wipe off excess
surface_prep: Sand to 220 grit. Apply liberally, let penetrate 10-15 minutes, then wipe off all excess to avoid a sticky surface.
description: A blend of oil and varnish that penetrates the wood grain for a natural, hand-rubbed look. Easy to apply and repair, though less protective than a film-forming finish.

name: GoldenGrain Pure Tung Oil
use_cases: Furniture, Cutting Boards & Butcher Block, Musical Instruments
surface_prep: Sand to 220-320 grit. Apply thin coats and buff off excess; thick coats will remain tacky.
description: 100% pure tung oil with no additives, food-safe once fully cured. Slower to build than blended oils but leaves a durable, water-resistant, natural finish prized for cutting boards and fine furniture.

name: AmberSeal Blonde Shellac Flakes (Pre-Mixed)
surface_prep: Sand to 220 grit. Apply in thin, even coats; shellac dries fast so work quickly and avoid overlapping wet edges.
description: A traditional natural resin finish that dries fast and sands easily between coats. Excellent as a sealer or standalone finish for furniture and instruments, though less water- and alcohol-resistant than modern coatings.

name: TrailBlazer Semi-Transparent Deck Stain
dry_time_recoat: 4 hours (if a second coat is needed)
surface_prep: Clean and de-grey the deck, let dry 24-48 hours before staining. Back-brush after spraying or rolling for even penetration.
description: A water-based, semi-transparent stain that lets wood grain show through while adding UV and moisture protection. Designed for exterior decking and fencing that sees weather exposure year-round.

name: IronClad 2K Epoxy Bar Top Coating
coverage: 1 kit (2L mixed) covers approx. 1 m² at 1mm thickness
thinner_cleanup: Acetone (uncured only); cured epoxy requires sanding to remove
surface_prep: Sand to 120-150 grit, seal porous wood or knots first to prevent outgassing bubbles. Work in a dust-free, temperature-controlled room.
description: A two-part, self-leveling epoxy resin system that cures to a thick, glass-like, high-gloss surface. Popular for bar tops and river tables. Requires precise mixing ratios and a dust-free work area.

name: SilkFinish Nitrocellulose Lacquer
surface_prep: Sand to 220 grit and apply a sanding sealer first. Spray in thin, even passes; avoid heavy, wet coats.
description: A fast-drying nitrocellulose lacquer favored by furniture makers and instrument builders for its ability to be rubbed out to a glass-smooth finish. Not recommended for exterior use.

name: HeritageWax Natural Furniture Wax
sheen: Soft Matte to Low Sheen (buffs to a soft glow)
application_method: Apply with a cloth, buff with a soft brush or cloth
dry_time_cure: N/A (buffed, not cured like a film finish)
thinner_cleanup: Mineral spirits (for tools); wax itself is wiped, not diluted
surface_prep: Use over an existing sealed finish or bare wood. Apply a thin, even layer and let haze before buffing.
description: A blend of natural waxes that adds a soft sheen and light protection, most often used as a final top coat over an existing finish or on turned woodwork. Not a standalone protective finish for high-wear surfaces.

name: AquaShield Water-Based Polyurethane - Matte
surface_prep: Sand to 180-220 grit, remove dust with a tack cloth. Bare wood only; no wax or silicone residue.
description: The matte-sheen version of our low-odor water-based polyurethane. Same fast-drying, non-yellowing formula, for projects where a flat, contemporary look is preferred over gloss or satin.

name: FieldStone Exterior Wood Stain & Sealer
surface_prep: Pressure wash and let dry 48 hours. Sand rough or splintered areas. Prime bare or weathered wood if recommended on the label.
description: An opaque, paint-like stain that fully hides wood grain while providing strong UV and moisture protection. A good option for older or weathered decking and siding where a uniform color is wanted.

name: Luthier's Choice French Polish Shellac
coats_recommended: Many thin layers built up over multiple sessions
surface_prep: Grain must be fully filled and sanded to at least 320 grit before polishing begins. Requires a dust-free, warm workspace.
description: A super-blonde shellac cut specifically for the French polishing technique used on violins, guitars, and fine furniture. Builds a deep, glass-like gloss through many thin, hand-applied layers.
